  • Reference

    Residuals for matrices

    compute_residual_stats.Rd

    Root Mean Squared Residual Number of absolute residuals > 0.05 Proportion of absolute residuals > 0.05. It can either accept a psych EFA model or it can compare two correlation or covariance matrices

    compute_residual_stats(model, data = NULL)

    Arguments

    model

    psych EFA model. It has to be a correlation or covariance matrix if data is not NULL

    data

    correlation or covariance matrix

    Examples

    model<-psych::fa(mtcars,nfactors=2,rotate="oblimin",fm="pa",oblique.scores=TRUE)
compute_residual_stats(model)
#>                       residual_statistics       value critical
#> 1              Root Mean Squared Residual  0.04419293       NA
#> 2     Number of absolute residuals > 0.05 13.00000000       NA
#> 3 Proportion of absolute residuals > 0.05  0.23636364      0.5
#>                                formula
#> 1              sqrt(mean(residuals^2))
#> 2                  abs(residuals)>0.05
#> 3 numberLargeResiduals/nrow(residuals)
